body_markdown:
**DENVER – Nov. 18, 2026** – Frontier Airlines (Nasdaq: ULCC) today launched its 2027 GoWild Annual Pass, offering easier access to unlimited travel than ever before. For the first time, the GoWild Pass will have no blackout dates, with new peak travel day booking options and expanded early booking options (additional charges may apply).** Consumers can purchase the pass for just $399 - or $349 for Discount Den members* – and begin flying right away, enjoying unlimited travel across Frontier’s expansive network through Dec. 31, 2027. Frontier currently has opened reservations through Aug. 16, 2027, providing GoWild passholders with the ability to plan and book travel through the winter, spring, and summer months now.


“For 2027, we’re making the GoWild Pass easier to use by removing blackout dates and expanding early booking options,” said James Fenner, Chief Revenue Officer, Frontier Airlines. “With destinations across the U.S., Caribbean, and Latin America, Frontier’s 2027 GoWild Pass offers unlimited, all-you-can-fly access to both spontaneous travel and advance booking at the unbeatable price point of $399.”


**What you get with the 2027 GoWild Annual Pass****


- Introductory price of just $399 ($349 for Discount Den members)*


- Existing 2026-2027 GoWild Annual Passholders can early renew and extend their pass validity through Dec. 31, 2028, for just $499 (compared to the standard renewal price of $699) for a limited time


- Immediate access, allowing passholders to begin flying right away and enjoy unlimited travel with Frontier through Dec. 31, 2027


- $0.01 airfare per flight segment (plus taxes, fees and charges; subject to availability), when booking flights within the day before flight departure for domestic travel and 10 days before flight departure for international travel. Additional charges may apply for peak travel days


- Ability to plan ahead with early booking and no blackout dates (additional charges may apply)


-


Earn miles and Elite Status points when buying the pass and on extras like bundles, bags and seats


To learn more about the 2027 GoWild Annual Pass, and to buy it before the price goes up,


[click here](https://www.flyfrontier.com/deals/gowild-pass/?mobile=true) .


Frontier Airlines is on a mission to prove that travel can be both low cost and high value, and has introduced premium product and customer service offerings while maintaining its signature affordable fares. First Class seats and Premium seats with extra-legroom are now being implemented across the airline’s fleet, with reservations open for travel starting March 5, 2027. Additional enhancements, including high-speed Starlink Wi-Fi and in-seat power in the first eight rows of every aircraft will begin rolling out in 2027, further upgrading the onboard experience.


***GoWild Terms and Conditions:** **$349 Discount Den® Offer:** Available to eligible customers with an active Discount Den® membership. Customers must be logged in to the FRONTIER Miles™ account associated with their membership at purchase. Limit one promotional pass per eligible member. Eligibility and price shown at checkout control. Offer is non-transferable, has no cash value, and is subject to availability. Frontier reserves the right to verify eligibility and correct or cancel purchases resulting from ineligibility, fraud, abuse, or technical or pricing errors.


****General GoWild Terms:** The 2027 GoWild Annual Pass is available for $399 to the general public and $349 to eligible Discount Den members. The pass is valid for eligible travel from the date of purchase through December 31, 2027. Passholders may book unlimited eligible GoWild flights, subject to flight and seat availability. GoWild fares start at $0.01 in airfare per eligible flight segment when booked within the standard GoWild booking window, plus applicable taxes, fees, and charges. Domestic flights may be booked beginning the day before departure, and international flights beginning 10 days before departure. Early booking may be available for additional airfare, fees, and/or charges. No blackout dates apply; however, additional airfare, fees, and/or charges may apply for travel on designated peak days. Flights and seats are capacity controlled, and last-seat availability is not guaranteed. Bags, advance seat assignments, and other optional services are not included unless otherwise provided. The GoWild Pass is non-transferable and automatically renews unless canceled in accordance with the applicable program terms. Additional terms and conditions apply. Visit


[https://www.flyfrontier.com/frontiermiles/terms-and-conditions/](https://www.flyfrontier.com/frontiermiles/terms-and-conditions/) .


***Important Things to Know About the GoWild Pass:***


- *Flights can be booked and confirmed the day before flight departure for domestic travel and 10 days before flight departure for international travel*
- *Plan ahead and book select flights early. Simply search and choose GoWild when available. Higher fares and/or charges may apply*
- *Flights must be booked at FlyFrontier.com or the Frontier mobile app*
- *Flights do not include any add-on products like bundles, bags or seat assignments, which are available for purchase*
- *For each flight segment, passholders pay $0.01 in airfare plus applicable taxes, fees and charges at the time of booking. Additional fees or airfare may apply for early booking and peak dates*
- *Flights and seats are subject to availability; last seat availability is not guaranteed*
- *The GoWild Pass is non-transferable. The passholder is the only passenger allowed to travel with GoWild Pass privileges*
- *Your pass will automatically renew unless you cancel. Customers may opt out of auto renewal on their Frontier Airlines profile page*
- *You must be 18 years or older and a resident of the United States to purchase the GoWild Pass. The passholder may be under the age of 18 and must be a resident of the United States. Passholders under the age of 13 must be enrolled by their parent or legal guardian. Children under the age of 15 must travel accompanied by a passenger who is at least 15 years old*
- *Seats available to passholders are capacity controlled, limited in quantity and are offered on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last*
